---
title: "Age profiles with Arrow and DuckDB"
output: html_notebook
---

Do retained male and female cards have the same age profile?
Use Arrow to select the card fields, then DuckDB for the grouped counts.

```{r setup}
library(arrow)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

root <- path.expand("~/Documents/work/data_work/bangalore/voters/final_roll_2026")
data_dir <- file.path(root, "data_combined")

dbConnect(duckdb()) ->
  con

open_dataset(data_dir) %>%
  filter(is_deleted == FALSE) %>%
  select(age, gender) %>%
  to_duckdb(con = con) ->
  ages
```

First look at the age readings before choosing the comparison range.

```{r age-readings}
ages %>%
  mutate(
    age_status = case_when(
      is.na(age) ~ "Unread",
      age < 18 ~ "Below 18",
      age < 20 ~ "18–19",
      age > 99 ~ "100+",
      TRUE ~ "20–99"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_status) %>%
  collect()
```

There are 1,228 unread ages and seven readings below 18 among retained cards.
The 789 readings of 100+ need source checks before being treated as centenarians.

Compare complete ten-year bands from 20 to 99. Leave the two-year 18–19 group out of this chart.

```{r age-profile}
ages %>%
  filter(
    age >= 20,
    age <= 99
  ) %>%
  mutate(age_band = 10 * floor(age / 10)) %>%
  count(age_band, gender) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(gender %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  mutate(
    share = n / sum(n),
    .by = gender
  ) %>%
  arrange(gender, age_band) ->
  age_profile
```

```{r age-profile-plot}
age_profile %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = age_band,
    y = share
  )) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#0072B2",
    width = 8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~gender) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(20, 90, 10),
    labels = paste0(seq(20, 90, 10), "–", seq(29, 99, 10))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Both age profiles peak in the forties",
    subtitle = "Retained cards aged 20–99; each gender sums to 100%",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share within gender",
    caption = "Source: November 2026 final-roll card OCR. Other/unread gender excluded."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

The thirties and forties together account for a larger share of female cards than male cards.
This describes the recorded electorate; it is not Bangalore's population age distribution.

```{r disconnect}
dbDisconnect(
  con,
  shutdown = TRUE
)
```
